-- 1. Full channel breadth + spend by channel/tactic in Display

       COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(Spend) AS total_spend,
       MIN(Date) AS min_date, MAX(Date) AS max_date
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_display
GROUP BY Channel_Group_Name, Media_Tactic, Platform
ORDER BY total_spend DESC;

-- 3. What source views feed the integrated snapshot, and how much spend each contributes
SELECT view_source, Channel_Group_Name,
       COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(Spend) AS total_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
GROUP BY view_source, Channel_Group_Name
ORDER BY view_source, total_spend DESC;

-- 4. Reconciliation: weekly spend for the 3 biddable channel groups in the integrated
-- snapshot, vs. the weekly totals already in your Biddable Spend Bronze table
SELECT Week_Start_Mon, Channel_Group_Name, SUM(Spend) AS integrated_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name IN ('Programmatic', 'Paid Social', 'Paid Search')
GROUP BY Week_Start_Mon, Channel_Group_Name
ORDER BY Week_Start_Mon DESC, Channel_Group_Name;

-- 5. Weekly Programmatic-only spend from media_analytics_display (true biddable subset)
SELECT Week_Start_Mon,
       CASE WHEN Media_Tactic LIKE 'Programmatic%' THEN 'Programmatic' ELSE 'Direct/Other' END AS biddable_flag,
       Channel_Group_Name, Platform,
       SUM(Spend) AS total_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_display
WHERE Media_Tactic LIKE 'Programmatic%'
GROUP BY Week_Start_Mon, biddable_flag, Channel_Group_Name, Platform
ORDER BY Week_Start_Mon DESC;

-- Paid Search, engine breakdown via Account_Type, week derived to match Bronze's Sun-Sat convention
SELECT
    date_add(Date, pmod(7 - dayofweek(Date), 7)) AS week_end_sat,
    Account_Type,
    SUM(Spend) AS integrated_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name = 'Paid Search'
GROUP BY week_end_sat, Account_Type
ORDER BY week_end_sat DESC;
output:
week_end_sat	Account_Type	integrated_spend
2026-09-12	ENGINE_TRACK	42483.85153079033
2026-09-12	MICROSOFT	209501.45979977268
2026-09-12	UNKNOWN	0

-- Paid Social, Facebook + Instagram collapsed to match Bronze's single "Meta" platform, same derived week
SELECT
    date_add(Date, pmod(7 - dayofweek(Date), 7)) AS week_end_sat,
    CASE WHEN Channel_Name IN ('Paid Social - Facebook','Paid Social - Instagram') THEN 'Meta'
         ELSE REPLACE(Channel_Name, 'Paid Social - ', '') END AS platform_norm,
    SUM(Spend) AS integrated_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name = 'Paid Social'
GROUP BY week_end_sat, platform_norm
ORDER BY week_end_sat DESC;

-- Integrated Snapshot, Meta, monthly
SELECT date_trunc('month', Date) AS month, SUM(Spend) AS integrated_meta_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
WHERE Channel_Group_Name = 'Paid Social'
  AND Channel_Name IN ('Paid Social - Facebook','Paid Social - Instagram')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC;

-- Bronze, Meta, monthly (approximated via each week's Saturday-ending date —
-- imprecise for weeks that straddle a month boundary, but good enough to test the hypothesis)
SELECT date_trunc('month', week_sun_sat) AS month, SUM(spend) AS bronze_meta_spend
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.sdi_tbl_dashboardPulseTms_bronze_biddableSpend_weekly
WHERE channel_group = 'Paid Social' AND platform = 'Meta'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC;

-- Bronze's raw TikTok campaigns for the same week — adjust column names once
-- the DESCRIBE above comes back; campaign/date/spend column names are placeholders
SELECT campaign_name, campaign_id, SUM(spend) AS spend, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM prd_dbi_analytics.improvado.mrt_paidsocial_pivot
WHERE channel = 'TikTok'
  AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-02' AND '2026-08-08'
GROUP BY campaign_name, campaign_id
ORDER BY spend DESC;

-- Meta: full diff between Integrated Snapshot and Bronze's raw source, one settled week
WITH integrated AS (
  SELECT Campaign_ID, Campaign_Name, SUM(Spend) AS spend
  FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
  WHERE Channel_Name IN ('Paid Social - Facebook','Paid Social - Instagram')
    AND Date BETWEEN '2026-08-02' AND '2026-08-08'
  GROUP BY Campaign_ID, Campaign_Name
),
bronze_raw AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, SUM(spend) AS spend
  FROM prd_dbi_analytics.improvado.mrt_paidsocial_pivot
  WHERE channel = 'Meta'
    AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-02' AND '2026-08-08'
  GROUP BY campaign_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(i.Campaign_ID, b.campaign_id) AS campaign_id,
  i.Campaign_Name,
  i.spend AS integrated_spend,
  b.spend AS bronze_spend,
  CASE
    WHEN b.campaign_id IS NULL THEN 'integrated_only'
    WHEN i.Campaign_ID IS NULL THEN 'bronze_only'
    ELSE 'in_both'
  END AS status
FROM integrated i
FULL OUTER JOIN bronze_raw b ON i.Campaign_ID = b.campaign_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(i.spend, b.spend, 0) DESC;

-- Same diff, rolled up to totals per status — this is the number that matters
WITH integrated AS (
  SELECT Campaign_ID, SUM(Spend) AS spend
  FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.media_analytics_integrated_snapshot
  WHERE Channel_Name IN ('Paid Social - Facebook','Paid Social - Instagram')
    AND Date BETWEEN '2026-08-02' AND '2026-08-08'
  GROUP BY Campaign_ID
),
bronze_raw AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, SUM(spend) AS spend
  FROM prd_dbi_analytics.improvado.mrt_paidsocial_pivot
  WHERE channel = 'Meta'
    AND date BETWEEN '2026-08-02' AND '2026-08-08'
  GROUP BY campaign_id
),
diffed AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(i.campaign_id, b.campaign_id) AS campaign_id,
    i.spend AS integrated_spend,
    b.spend AS bronze_spend,
    CASE WHEN b.campaign_id IS NULL THEN 'integrated_only'
         WHEN i.campaign_id IS NULL THEN 'bronze_only'
         ELSE 'in_both' END AS status
  FROM integrated i
  FULL OUTER JOIN bronze_raw b ON i.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS campaigns,
       SUM(COALESCE(integrated_spend,0)) AS integrated_total,
       SUM(COALESCE(bronze_spend,0)) AS bronze_total
FROM diffed
GROUP BY status;
